Class MockupPlayer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.client.view.mockupModel.MockupPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MockupPlayer extends Object implements Serializable
The MockupPlayer class represents the client-side snapshot of a specific player. It stores all the publicly or locally known information about the player, including their resources (food, points), their assigned totem, their connection status, and the cards they have played (characters and buildings). It also provides utility methods to render this information gracefully on a CLI using JLine.

    • displayAttributedStringName

      public org.jline.utils.AttributedString displayAttributedStringName()
      Generates a stylized string for the player's name, color-coded based on their status:
      • Red: It is currently this player's turn.
      • Yellow: The player is connected and waiting.
      • Black (Bold): The player is disconnected.
      It also prepends the player's colored totem symbol (or a placeholder if null).
      Returns:
      the formatted AttributedString for the player's display name.

    • displayAttributedStringStats

      public org.jline.utils.AttributedString displayAttributedStringStats()

      Returns:
      the formatted AttributedString of the player's stats.
